title: Alarms raised before #258 redrawn in today's words (no host, caller or job id in a title)
why: An alarm keeps the title it was raised with: a held trip's raiser doesn't fire again, so the alarms open since before #258 still read 'index.commoncrawl.org: Its server failed (the crawler, on Railway)', 'The job "identity_recheck_tick" never finished' and 'W1: its task overture_bulk failed (run #1290)'. The board's watch now redraws each open alarm's title from its state with the same words today's raiser uses (a service by its part's name, a job by its plain name, a task by its endpoint or its own code), and its Pulse thread's title in place. Nothing is sent, nothing made unread, nothing else changes; a second pass changes nothing (words follow the state, principle 4; the session manager, 2026-11-23).

changes.what: The alarms' titles on the System Control Board
The same alarms' titles in Pulse
